license_interpretation: The SAM License is Meta's own agreement, not an OSI-approved license like MIT or Apache-2.0. It grants a worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, distribute and create derivative works, and does not itself say the weights are non-commercial. It does add terms Apache and MIT do not: publications that use the results must acknowledge SAM Materials, reverse engineering is prohibited, use is subject to export-control and sanctions compliance, filing IP litigation against Meta over the materials terminates your license, and Meta may amend the agreement. This page also covers SAM 3.1 (key sam31), the retrained detector release from the same facebookresearch/sam3 project, whose weights are under the same SAM License. SAM 3 weights are gated on facebook/sam3 on Hugging Face: you must accept the terms there and authenticate before downloading, and LibreYOLO does not redistribute them. SAM 3.1 weights come from facebook/sam3.1 at revision daa63191845a41281374e725f4c9e51c7a824460; because the SAM License permits redistribution when its terms are passed through, LibreYOLO mirrors the converted image path (detector and interactive head, no learned value changed, Object Multiplex video weights not included) at LibreYOLO/LibreSAM31large with the license verbatim and its own access gate, so you must accept the terms there too. LibreYOLO runs both through the Apache-2.0 Transformers SAM 3 implementation and vendors none of Meta's model source; only the SAM 3.1 key mapping is adapted from the Apache-2.0 Transformers converters. Neither set of weights is covered by LibreYOLO's MIT license; read the SAM License yourself before relying on it commercially.
